visibility_m.description: Depth at which the bottom fades out, metres (> 0): ~30 crystal clear, 15 open ocean, 3 murky.

tint.description: Colour of the suspended matter scattered back, linear RGB 0..1.

wind_speed_mps.description: Wind speed 10 m above the sea, m/s (≥ 0; 0 = flat calm): 3 ripples, 8 moderate sea, 20 gale.

fetch_km.description: Fetch, km: how far the wind has blown over open water (> 0). Omit for a fully developed sea.

wind_azimuth_deg.description: Where the wind blows FROM, degrees clockwise from north; waves travel the opposite way.

max_px.description: Largest side of the depth / colour / foam maps, pixels.

wave_px.description: Side of the tileable wave normal map, pixels.

wave_tile_m.description: World size the wave tile covers, metres; omit for a quarter of the world's width.

dir.description: Output directory; relative paths resolve against the project's `exports/`.
